description: This file defines an interface named MonitoringMiddlewareInterface within the Aws\ClientSideMonitoring namespace. It specifies methods for retrieving request and response data related to monitoring, and a method to invoke the middleware with command and request objects.

classes.name: MonitoringMiddlewareInterface
classes.description: An internal interface in the Aws SDK defining methods for monitoring middleware, including data extraction for requests and responses, and invocation of middleware with command and request objects.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Static method to retrieve request data for monitoring purposes, given a RequestInterface object.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Static method to retrieve response or error data for monitoring, given a ResultInterface, AwsException, or generic Exception.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Method to invoke the middleware with a command and request, typically for processing or monitoring.
